cards.name: beneficiary-device-issued-check
cards.description: A beneficiary has received a device if the 'Assistive Device Issued' column is not null or empty.
cards.claim: To determine if a beneficiary has received a device, check if the 'Assistive Device Issued' column is not NULL and not an empty string.

cards.name: device-inventory-current-stock
cards.description: Current stock for a device type is the 'balance_after' from the most recent transaction (by date and txn_id) for that type.
cards.claim: To find current stock, use the 'balance_after' value from the latest transaction (ordered by date DESC, then txn_id DESC) for each device_type. Do not use MAX(balance_after) as it may reflect a past peak rather than current status.
